text.en: CVE-2026-126196, published in NVD on 12 November 2026, affects pgEdge Postgres MCP Server before 1.1.0: query_database on read-only connections could run several statements in one request, according to NVD.
text.es: CVE-2026-126196, publicado en NVD el 12 de noviembre de 2026, afecta a pgEdge Postgres MCP Server antes de 1.1.0: query_database en conexiones de solo lectura podía ejecutar varias sentencias en una petición, según NVD.
text.ca: CVE-2026-126196, publicat a NVD el 12 de novembre de 2026, afecta pgEdge Postgres MCP Server abans de 1.1.0: query_database en connexions de només lectura podia executar diverses sentències en una petició, segons NVD.

text.en: CVE-2026-126197, published in NVD on 12 November 2026, affects pgEdge Postgres MCP Server before 1.1.0: arguments to custom pl-do tools could inject SQL statements, according to NVD.
text.es: CVE-2026-126197, publicado en NVD el 12 de noviembre de 2026, afecta a pgEdge Postgres MCP Server antes de 1.1.0: los argumentos de las herramientas pl-do personalizadas podían inyectar sentencias SQL, según NVD.
text.ca: CVE-2026-126197, publicat a NVD el 12 de novembre de 2026, afecta pgEdge Postgres MCP Server abans de 1.1.0: els arguments de les eines pl-do personalitzades podien injectar sentències SQL, segons NVD.

text.en: CVE-2026-126198, published in NVD on 12 November 2026, affects pgEdge Postgres MCP Server before 1.1.0: its bundled clients skipped write confirmation for custom tools, according to NVD.
text.es: CVE-2026-126198, publicado en NVD el 12 de noviembre de 2026, afecta a pgEdge Postgres MCP Server antes de 1.1.0: sus clientes incluidos no pedían confirmación de escritura para herramientas personalizadas, según NVD.
text.ca: CVE-2026-126198, publicat a NVD el 12 de novembre de 2026, afecta pgEdge Postgres MCP Server abans de 1.1.0: els seus clients inclosos no demanaven confirmació d'escriptura per a eines personalitzades, segons NVD.

held.text_en: CVE-2026-126199, published in NVD on 12 November 2026, affects pgEdge Postgres MCP Server before 1.1.0: its bundled clients classified statements by first keyword before asking for write confirmation.
CVE-2026-123139, published in NVD on 12 November 2026, affects the Opera Neon MCP Hub extension 0.0.1: another browser extension can send commands through MCP Hub to Browser Operator.
Antigravity CLI 1.5.7, dated 12 November 2026, changes the default Agent Mode from Default to Auto, including headless -p runs, according to its changelog.
Kiro CLI 3.3.0, dated 12 November 2026, keeps a V2 agent's allow rules from widening when it is upgraded to V3.
Kiro records calls to Kiro service MCP tools in AWS CloudTrail in us-east-1 and eu-central-1, with tool arguments redacted, dated 12 November 2026.
Claude Code 2.1.323, dated 12 November 2026, adds the experimental opt-in Code Mode and an engines field in plugin.json that limits which plugins load.
GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.110, dated 12 November 2026, adds an experimental masked dialog for git, ssh and sudo password prompts from agent commands.
CodeBuddy Code v2.184.0, dated 13 November 2026, adds an explicit switch to run single literal osascript commands outside the macOS sandbox, under existing approvals.
MAL-2026-19224 lists npm package helper-agent as malicious, dated 13 November 2026.
held.reason: The OSV record does not tie helper-agent to any tracked agent; it is not an MCP server, package or extension they use.
